selection_rule: validation only: F1, then recall, then lower FPR; exact ties prefer override_high (keeps high-severity rule evidence for analyst triage at zero measured validation cost)
feature_level_not_used: decision-level chosen: validation had no recall headroom for a meta-model to learn from, and feature-level fusion would need out-of-fold base scores; the decision policy is auditable
reported_test_and_holdout_scores: from this script after the policy was frozen; rules, base thresholds and policy family were not tuned on test/holdout
